title: A Rabbit with a Watch
author: Lewis Carroll
summaryZh: 一个平凡又无聊的下午，因为一只会看时间的兔子变得不同。

vocabulary.noteZh: peep into a book：朝书里瞄一眼
burning with curiosity：好奇心非常强烈

questions.prompt: What finally makes Alice jump to her feet?
options: The Rabbit looks at a watch from its pocket.
A daisy falls into the water.
questions.explanation: 第 3 段先说兔子开口说话让她觉得自然，随后 but when 转到兔子掏出怀表看时间，接着才写 Alice started to her feet。这个转折直接对应第一项。
hints: 区分爱丽丝觉得自然的事情与让她真正惊讶的事情。
第 3 段 but when 引出转折；看 Alice started to her feet 之前，兔子做了什么。
questions.evidence: but when the Rabbit actually took a watch out of its waistcoat-pocket, and looked at it, and then hurried on, Alice started to her feet

evidenceSpans.text: but when the Rabbit actually took a watch out of its waistcoat-pocket, and looked at it, and then hurried on, Alice started to her feet

questions.prompt: What does Alice consider before entering the hole?
options: Nothing about how she will get out.
questions.explanation: 末段 never once considering how ... she was to get out again 表示她一次也没有考虑怎样出来，支持第二项；不是说她考虑了洞有多深或姐姐能否跟来。
hints: 题目考查她进入洞穴时有没有考虑后果，不要把自己的常识补进故事。
最后一段 never once 否定 considering；核对 how 引出的具体问题。
questions.evidence: In another moment down went Alice after it, never once considering how in the world she was to get out again.

text:
Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to do: once or twice she had peeped into the book her sister was reading, but it had no pictures or conversations in it, “and what is the use of a book,” thought Alice “without pictures or conversations?”

So she was considering in her own mind (as well as she could, for the hot day made her feel very sleepy and stupid), whether the pleasure of making a daisy-chain would be worth the trouble of getting up and picking the daisies, when suddenly a White Rabbit with pink eyes ran close by her.

There was nothing so very remarkable in that; nor did Alice think it so very much out of the way to hear the Rabbit say to itself, “Oh dear! Oh dear! I shall be late!” (when she thought it over afterwards, it occurred to her that she ought to have wondered at this, but at the time it all seemed quite natural); but when the Rabbit actually took a watch out of its waistcoat-pocket, and looked at it, and then hurried on, Alice started to her feet, for it flashed across her mind that she had never before seen a rabbit with either a waistcoat-pocket, or a watch to take out of it, and burning with curiosity, she ran across the field after it, and fortunately was just in time to see it pop down a large rabbit-hole under the hedge.

In another moment down went Alice after it, never once considering how in the world she was to get out again.

sentenceAnalysis.sentence: In another moment down went Alice after it, never once considering how in the world she was to get out again.
sentenceAnalysis.translation: 转眼间，爱丽丝也跟着跳了下去，丝毫没有考虑自己到底该怎么再出来。
sentenceAnalysis.analysis: down went Alice 是倒装语序，正常顺序为 Alice went down，用来突出向下跳的动作。never once considering… 是现在分词短语，补充说明她跳下去时的状态；how… 是 considering 的宾语从句。
